notes: Hard bucket (total 19). Three independent extraction sub-tasks the verifier re-runs on fresh fixtures: (1) a pypdf form-field enumerator re-run on three hidden forms (with-label, one with NO /TU label, and one with zero controls); (2) a rdflib SPARQL walk from Recruit->firm running on two hidden graphs with decoy triples (un-named recruit, un-typed seconded entity, firm with no name, duplicate secondments requiring DISTINCT), asserting exact result-variable binding; (3) a byte-faithful skinned-mesh decoder compared against an independent struct/numpy reference read of the same binary across three valid layouts and one torn/malformed file that must fail cleanly. reasoning_depth + dependent_stages of three chained independent competencies drive the hard bucket; generalized hidden inputs in every gate require runnable deliverables, not one-shot answers.
